newsitem.title: GERMANY: German beet continues to show high sugar content.
newsitem.headline: German beet continues to show high sugar content.

text.p: German sugar beet deliveries to refineries as of November 29 were 21.92 million tonnes, down from 22.29 million a year earlier, but sugar content was above last year, sugar industry association WVZ said.
The 10th weekly campaign report put average sugar content at 18.18 percent versus 16.74 percent a year earlier.
WVZ maintained its forecast for final beet deliveries in 1996/97 of 25.80 million tonnes, down from 26.05 million in 1995/96.
Deliveries to refineries up to Nov 22 were 19.73 million tonnes, down from 19.94 million last year, with sugar content at 18.16 percent versus 16.74.
WVZ runs weekly delivery updates until the end of the campaign in January.
